Implementation Plan

Overview
CutiKu is a fully client-side single-page app (no auth, no D1 changes needed — trip plans are transient; optional "Simpan Rencana" uses localStorage, which is runtime-safe). The existing template Worker, `items` table, seeds, and migrations stay untouched. All planning logic (holiday-aware date suggestions, itinerary generation, budget simulation) runs in the browser from realistic static datasets in Bahasa Indonesia.

Data layer (new folder `src/data/`)
- `holidays.ts` — Indonesian national holidays + cuti bersama for 2025 and 2026 (fixed dates like Tahun Baru, Kemerdekaan, Natal, plus movable ones: Nyepi, Idul Fitri, Waisak, Idul Adha, dll). Shape: `{ date: "2025-03-31", name: "Hari Raya Idul Fitri", type: "libur" | "cuti-bersama" }`.
- `cities.ts` — ~120 world cities: `{ name, country, countryId, lat?, popular: boolean }`. Flag `popular` marks ~20 destinations with full detail data.
- `destinations.ts` — rich profiles for popular cities (Bali/Denpasar, Yogyakarta, Bandung, Lombok, Labuan Bajo, Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Bangkok, Tokyo, Osaka, Seoul, Paris, Dubai, Sydney, Istanbul, dll): 6–8 attractions with names, short descriptions, ticket price estimates, and 3–5 Unsplash photo URLs (images.unsplash.com pinned photo IDs), signature foods with price ranges, local transport notes, typical daily pacing. Fallback `genericProfile(city)` builds a plausible profile for any non-popular city so autocomplete never dead-ends.
- `pricing.ts` — per-city baseline flight cost from major Indonesian hubs (distance-band based: domestik Rp600rb–3jt, ASEAN Rp1,5–4jt, Asia Rp3–8jt, Eropa/Australia Rp6–15jt), hotel tiers (budget/mid/premium per night), meal/day, local transport/day. Deterministic pseudo-random jitter (seeded by city-pair string hash) so results look real but stable.

Logic layer (`src/lib/`)
- `dateUtils.ts` — add days, format Indonesian long dates (`Intl.DateTimeFormat("id-ID")`), day names, weekend checks.
- `planner.ts` — core engine, pure functions:
  - `suggestDates(days, preferredStart, holidays)` → 3 options. Option A: user's chosen range. Option B & C: nearest windows that maximize "hari gratis" by bridging libur nasional/cuti bersama and weekends (scan ±30 days, score = total days off gained ÷ leave days used; detect harpitnas/long-weekend patterns). Each option returns `{ start, end, totalDaysOff, leaveDaysUsed, holidaysCovered[], reason }` with Indonesian reason text like "Menyambung long weekend Idul Fitri — 9 hari libur hanya pakai 3 hari cuti".
  - `buildItinerary(days, destinationProfile)` → per-day array with pagi/siang/sore/malam activities drawn from attractions, food, rest blocks; day 1 = arrival/travel, last day = checkout/pulang.
  - `estimateBudget(origin, dest, days, nights)` → breakdown: transport PP (flight primary + alternatif kereta/bus for nearby domestic), hotel per tier (budget/mid/premium per malam × nights), makan, transport lokal, tiket atraksi (sum of itinerary tickets), buffer 10%, total min–max range in Rupiah via `Intl.NumberFormat("id-ID", { style: "currency", currency: "IDR" })`.
- `storage.ts` — localStorage save/load/delete of named plans (guarded try/catch).

Components (`src/components/`)
- `Hero.tsx` — full-viewport gradient hero (sunset orange → violet), animated floating cloud/plane shapes via CSS keyframes, headline "Rencanakan Cuti Impianmu", CTA scrolls to form.
- `TripForm.tsx` — card form with: stepper input Lama Cuti (1–21 hari, +/- buttons); `<input type="date">` Tanggal Mulai default today, with live label "3–9 Jun 2025 (5 hari kerja + 2 hari libur)" syncing range to cuti length; two `CityAutocomplete` fields (asal default "Jakarta"); submit button "Buat Rencana ✈️" with loading shimmer (600ms simulated) then smooth-scroll to results. Validation: destination ≠ origin, both required; inline error messages.
- `CityAutocomplete.tsx` — controlled input, filtered dropdown (max 8, match name/country, case-insensitive), keyboard navigation (ArrowUp/Down, Enter, Escape), `role="combobox"`/`aria-expanded`/`aria-activedescendant`, click-outside close, lucide `MapPin` icons.
- `DateOptions.tsx` — 3 cards (badge "Paling Efektif" on best score) showing date range, leave-days-used vs total-days-off stat chips, covered holidays with `Calendar` icon, reason text. Selecting a card re-renders itinerary/budget for that range.
- `Itinerary.tsx` — vertical timeline per day: day header (Hari 1 — Sen, 3 Jun), photo strip (destination images, lazy-loaded, `onError` fallback to gradient placeholder with city initial), four activity blocks (Pagi/Siang/Sore/Malam) with lucide icons (`Sunrise/Sun/Sunset/Moon`).
- `Budget.tsx` — Rupiah breakdown table (transport, hotel 3 tiers toggle, makan, transport lokal, tiket, buffer) + highlighted total range; hotel tier tabs recompute total; note "Estimasi simulasi berdasarkan rata-rata harga OTA".
- `SavedPlans.tsx` — header button "Rencana Tersimpan" opens panel listing localStorage plans (label: tujuan + tanggal), click to reload into results, delete per item; empty state copy.
- `Header.tsx`/`Footer.tsx` — sticky translucent header with logo (lucide `Palmtree`), anchor nav (Form, Hasil, Tentang), footer disclaimer bahwa data bersifat simulasi.

App wiring
- Rewrite `src/main.tsx`: single `App` composing Header → Hero → TripForm → results section (DateOptions, Itinerary, Budget, hidden until submit) → SavedPlans → Footer. State lives in App: `{ days, startDate, origin, destination }`, `selectedOption`, `hotelTier`, `plan` (computed via `planner.ts` on submit). No router needed (single route; no pathname/query matching concerns).
- `index.html`: `lang="id"`, title "CutiKu – Perencana Cuti & Liburan", meta description, Google Fonts (Plus Jakarta Sans) via `<link>`.
- `src/styles.css`: keep resets, add Tailwind v4 `@theme` tokens (brand colors, display font), keyframe utilities (fade-up on scroll via IntersectionObserver hook `src/hooks/useReveal.ts`, float, shimmer), respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

Design & responsiveness
- Mobile-first: form fields stack (grid-cols-1 → md:grid-cols-2), itinerary timeline collapses to single column, date-option cards stack; sticky header with compact logo. Breakpoints sm/md/lg.
- Smooth animations: reveal-on-scroll sections, hover lift on cards, animated counter on budget total, plane path animation in hero — all CSS/transform-based (Workers-safe, no extra deps). Dependencies: only existing `lucide-react` + Tailwind; no new packages.

Accessibility
- Labels on all inputs, `aria-live="polite"` on results region, focus-visible rings, color contrast ≥ 4.5:1 on text, keyboard-operable autocomplete and tier tabs, `alt` text on destination photos, reduced-motion media query disables animations.

Persistence
- None server-side; localStorage only for saved plans. No Worker, schema, migration, or seed changes. `src/lib/api.ts` (items demo) is deleted since unused; Worker left as-is.

Validation

Self-checks (manual, after `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass with no errors):
1. Page loads: hero, header nav anchors (Form/Hasil/Tentang) scroll to correct sections; footer disclaimer visible.
2. Form defaults: tanggal mulai = hari ini; range label updates when lama cuti stepper changes (e.g. 5 hari → "…–… (5 hari)").
3. Autocomplete: typing "yog" suggests Yogyakarta; keyboard arrows + Enter select; Escape closes; selecting same city as origin shows inline error and blocks submit; unknown free text still works via generic profile.
4. Submit: loading state appears, results scroll into view, `aria-live` announces; all three output sections render.
5. Date suggestions: 3 options shown; best option references a real holiday (test with cuti length 3–5 near Idul Fitri/Natal dates — reason mentions long weekend/harpitnas); clicking another option updates itinerary dates and budget.
6. Itinerary: number of day blocks equals lama cuti; each day has 4 waktu blocks; images render or fall back to placeholder (test with network throttling).
7. Budget: all line items in Rupiah format (Rp x.xxx.xxx); switching hotel tier tabs updates total; total = sum of parts ± buffer.
8. Save plan: "Simpan Rencana" adds entry; reload page → entry persists in Rencana Tersimpan; clicking restores results; delete removes it; empty state text shows when none saved.
9. Responsive: check 360px, 768px, 1280px — no horizontal scroll, form usable, cards stack.
10. Reduced motion: enable OS reduced-motion → animations stop.
11. `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` both succeed; no new dependencies, no Worker/D1 changes.

    )
      contains.push(ct);
    if (starts.length >= limit) break;
  }

export function findCity(name: string): City | undefined {
  const q = name.trim().toLowerCase();
  return CITIES.find((ct) => ct.name.toLowerCase() === q);
}

function hash(str: string): number {
  let h = 5381;
  for (let i = 0; i < str.length; i++) h = (h * 33 + str.charCodeAt(i)) >>> 0;
  return h;
}

const GENERIC_PHOTO_POOL: [string, string, string][] = [
  ["photo-1477959858617-67f85cf4f1df", "photo-1480714378408-67cf0d13bc1b", "photo-1449824913935-59a10b8d2000"],
  ["photo-1514565131-fce0801e5785", "photo-1494522855154-9297ac14b55f", "photo-1519501025264-65ba15a82390"],
  ["photo-1478860409698-8707f313ee8b", "photo-1444723121867-7a241cacace9", "photo-1500835556837-99ac94a94552"],
];

export function getProfile(cityName: string): DestinationProfile {
  const hit = byCity.get(cityName);
  if (hit) return hit;
  const h = hash(cityName);
  const attractions: Attraction[] = GENERIC_ATTRACTIONS.map((a, i) => ({
    ...a,
    name: i === 0 ? `Landmark utama ${cityName}` : a.name,
    ticket: [0, 25000, 0, 0, 0, 50000, 10000, 100000][i] ?? 0,
  }));
  const ids = GENERIC_PHOTO_POOL[h % GENERIC_PHOTO_POOL.length];
  return {
    city: cityName,
    tagline: `Jelajahi sisi terbaik ${cityName}`,
    attractions,
    foods: [
      { name: "Hidangan khas lokal", priceRange: "Rp30.000–70.000/porsi" },

    ],
    photos: [
      { url: unsplash(ids[0]), alt: `${cityName} — pemandangan 1` },
      { url: unsplash(ids[1]), alt: `${cityName} — pemandangan 2` },
      { url: unsplash(ids[2]), alt: `${cityName} — pemandangan 3` },
    ],
    transportNote:
      "Kombinasikan transportasi publik lokal, ojek/taksi online, dan jalan kaki di pusat kota.",
  };
}
